label: Absence of a pure perfection at an unlimited root: three explanations and compiled E and L
summary: #2145 Investigation 1. Encoded the owner's three explanations of a pure perfection's absence at a root over one admissible profile family (TruthCore.Causality.RootPerfectionExclusion): exclusion by the admissibility constraints alone, by the positive profile (jointly; a single excluder is one case and pairwise compatibility does not suffice), or unexplained. absenceTrichotomy and absenceTrichotomyExclusive prove classical coverage and exclusivity relative to one family; the background (fixed family, positive nature as Has-profile, no case through the selected grounding relation at a root, with the wider exclusion of extrinsic explanations an open bridge, purity outside the trichotomy) carries the content. The L bridge is derived in both limitation senses from joint compossibility plus the RootPurity bridge (structural) or a determination-to-esse bridge (formal); two root-reaching arguments compose E (no unexplained absence at actual roots) with L and the root's nonlimitation to conclude fe67d766, the second through rootUnlimited. Controls (two beings and one root relation; the anchoring control uses natural-number determinations) show each open premise of both routes load-bearing: the joint-conflict row is a non-contracting exclusion model in this encoding and fails only joint compossibility among the L inputs; the standing-rival row fails only E; exact closure fails pure admissibility; an infinite all-pure profile fails root-profile admissibility, and since no admissible profile contains it the root's absence is vacuously a positive-profile exclusion, so case (ii) needs the root's profile to be admissible (inadmissibility alone gives no vacuity, because the family need not be closed downward). The A8 classifier route makes absence itself limiting (contraposed fullness) and is not a discriminating L. Under the exercise-or-potency reading, pure act and ab esse ad posse, own aptitude and exercise coincide at an own-being source for self-directed contents; productive and exemplary roles survive in a joint model, not by a theorem: the #1892 ImpersonalEminence source, with its own capacity set equal to its apprehension and its Has profile linked to that apprehension by an explicit conjunct, satisfies the collapse premises and violates only E. A source whose Has profile has noesis but lacks an admissible pure determination violates E in the same form; it is a Has-profile parity check, not a personal variant of that source. E is neutral in form, but given the background it decides exactly the point at issue (restricted to pure determinations it is equivalent to the conclusion), so its support value equals the independent warrant for a closure principle at roots, which is not yet in the graph. Follow-up 2026-11-27 (#2145 lane 1b, after independent semantic challenge): under the sufficiency direction ExclusionFreeAdmissible (every profile in which no member requires the lack of members is admissible; weak sibling of MemberGroundedAdmissibility, strengthens relation registered) and PureRequiresNoPureLack, joint compossibility 500d0e2d, pure admissibility ee287fd3 and, with root purity 3b39e0ba, root-profile admissibility 0a9d3a40 are derived (zero-axiom). This is a relocation, not independent warrant: with the requirement relation free, the pair is equivalent to 'every all-pure profile is admissible' (sufficiencyPremisesIffAllPure; with member grounding also downward closure, premisesIffStructural), and under member grounding joint compossibility returns the purity premise for every finite set (finiteConverse). The only added thesis is the localization of incompatibility in what a member requires, carried by the intended reading of RequiresLack. The triple family (a, b, noesis never together, every pure pair admissible) fails sufficiency with no requirement and fails the purity premise when noesis requires the joint lack of a and b; joint compossibility fails in both (constitutiveControls). A requirement of presence (noesis needing an impure articulation) is a third, member-grounded option excluded by member grounding (presenceRequirement). The #2153 anchoring family is member-grounded (every determination requiring the lack of every infinite set) but fails sufficiency with purity (anchorFamilyGrounding). Localization and E share one rationale (negative facts at a root's profile have positive grounds), so they are not independent evidence. E against the graph: no existing node supplies a closure principle at roots for determinations; 608a262d, ContingentPSR and NecessaryPSR are contingency-restricted; FactPSR is unbound; the BruteContingencyParity norm supplies it only for a stance whose feature is 'necessary intrinsic fact about the foundation'; truthmaker maximalism (791bee74, 012a5ae5, 0f38a9c3) accepts a totality fact as maker of an absence, which is the rival's primitive closure.
blocker: The derivation is conditional. Open: joint compossibility of pure determinations within the admissible family (positive rationale from DEF-PURE-PERFECTION, not a proof); E, no unexplained absence at actual roots (neutral in form, but given the background it decides the point at issue, so its support value is the independent warrant for a closure principle at roots, not yet in the graph; the rival's primitive closure is coherent); the bridge that every extrinsic explanation of an absence at a root would supply an actual concrete ground, which ActualRoot does not contain; admissibility of noesis with simplicity and the other admissibility constraints (the articulation objection); admissibility of the root's actual profile; the determination-to-esse bridge; and purity of intellect itself, which the trichotomy does not classify. After lane 1b: joint compossibility, pure admissibility and root-profile admissibility are relocated into the sufficiency direction and the purity premise; their additional warrant is at most that of localization, which shares with E the unregistered demand that negative facts at a root have intrinsic grounds. Open: the omniscience-immutability candidate against the purity premise; the requirement-of-presence form of the articulation objection; whether a feature-uniform why-stance or a truthmaker bridge must cover a root's absences.

current_assessment.scope: Absence of a pure perfection, including noesis, at an actual root (#2153), extended by #2145 lane 1b: the constitutive reading of the admissible family (member grounding and its sufficiency direction) and the purity of requirements as inputs to joint compossibility, pure admissibility and root-profile admissibility; E against the graph's PSR, parity and truthmaker principles. The pure-perfection-to-intellect route to 29818edd is assessed in d3a0e98a and the note.
current_assessment.assessment: Conditional support for fe67d766 by the two #2153 routes; no premise is established. Joint compossibility 500d0e2d, pure admissibility ee287fd3 and, given root purity, root-profile admissibility 0a9d3a40 are now conclusions of the sufficiency direction of member grounding (63e88cef) and the purity of requirements (0c8631bd). That is a relocation of joint compossibility into requirement form, not independent warrant: with the requirement relation free the pair is equivalent to 'every all-pure profile is admissible', and under member grounding joint compossibility returns the purity premise for every finite set. The only added thesis is the localization of incompatibility in what a member requires. A joint exclusion of noesis among pure determinations (case ii) is therefore ungrounded (denying localization), grounded in a pure determination's requirement of a lack (denying the purity premise; immutability against tensed knowing is a recorded standing candidate), or grounded in a requirement of presence (the articulation objection's form, a case-ii family unless the required impure item is also excluded everywhere, which is not encoded). For case (i) the controls back only the first two options. Unexplained absence (iii) is excluded only by E. No existing node supplies E: the contingency-restricted PSRs, the unbound FactPSR, the BruteContingencyParity norm under an existence-fact feature and truthmaker maximalism (a totality fact makes an absence true) all leave it open. Localization and E share one rationale, that negative facts at a root's profile have positive grounds, so they are not independent evidence; a brute-negative-facts stance rejects both and applies equally to personal and impersonal roots. No unconditional winner.
current_assessment.next_test: Encode a truthmaker bridge requiring a root's absences to be made true by its admissibility constraints or positive profile rather than a totality fact, and test it on personal and impersonal roots alike; formalize the C comparison as a WhyStance over profile facts; encode the omniscience-immutability conflict as a RequiresLack instance and test the tensed/untensed reply; encode the #1879 articulation test as a requirement of presence and decide whether the required articulation must be impure at a simple source.
